business_problem: Cummins needed to prepare its data environment for the adoption of generative AI solutions.
solution_summary: Cummins, a Manufacturing organization in United States, modernized this security and compliance workload with Microsoft Purview Information Protection, SharePoint, Microsoft 365 E5, Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management, and Microsoft 365. Cummins needed to prepare its data environment for the adoption of generative AI solutions. Microsoft Purview Information Protection applies sensitivity labels and protections to enterprise files and records. SharePoint stores and shares enterprise documents and knowledge that feed business workflows. Microsoft 365 E5 provides the secure productivity and compliance suite underpinning collaboration and governance. Operational data and user activity flow through Microsoft Purview Information Protection, SharePoint, and Microsoft 365 E5, where the platform processes information and serves outputs back to business users. Applies automated information governance before broader AI adoption.

metrics: Cummins Inc., a global leader in power solutions, designs, manufactures, and distributes engines, generators, and related technologies with a focus on sustainability. Operating in more than 180 countries with approximately 76,500 employees, Cummins adeptly manages diverse regulations and sensitive data, including HR files, customer information, and intellectual property.

evidence_quotes: Cummins needed to prepare its data environment for the adoption of generative AI solutions.
Too much data means more records for generative AI solutions to sift through, and it can make eDiscovery more complex and expensive.

Cummins automated data classification and sensitivity labeling with Microsoft Purview Information Protection, to enforce data sensitivity levels and protections.  It deployed Purview Data Lifecycle Management to enforce customized file lifecycles.

When it comes to confidential information architecture, automation of information management ensures consistency. “Microsoft Purview helps preserve confidentiality of sensitive data because everything is seamlessly integrated. We can manage data in all our email messages and SharePoint sites, the entire Microsoft 365 environment. Automation reduces the risk of human error as well,” says Kichambare.
Managed access to clean data paves the way for safe adoption of generative AI.  Cummins automatically labeled and classified millions of files.
